context: A grandpa and grandkid spend a day in the country
purpose: Teach: 薪/館内/本館/防音/農作業/手洗い/補習/弾ける

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、薪、たくさんあるね。
lines.en: Grandpa, there's so much firewood here.
lines.style: Hushed, small voice filled with genuine wonder. Eyes wide. Speaking almost to himself as much as to the old man. Slow, reverent pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うん。資料館の館内、見学しよう。
lines.en: Yeah. Let's have a look around the museum.
lines.style: Unhurried, warm acknowledgment. A gentle invitation rather than a command. Patient — giving the boy time to take it all in. Soft eye-crinkles.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: The main building is so big!
lines.style: High, bright, unguarded excitement. Quick breath intake before speaking. Bouncing slightly on the words. The pure wonder of a child discovering scale for the first time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔の家、防音、なかったから、すべて筒抜けだった。
lines.en: Old houses had no soundproofing, so everything echoed through.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost talking to himself. Gaze distant — remembering or imagining. Measured tempo. Slightly trailing off, as if lost in the image.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Rice-planting and farm work — that sounds fun!
lines.style: Genuine delight breaking through. Less performed enthusiasm than real connection to the idea. A small laugh tucked under the words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 手洗いは、外の井戸でしてたな、昔。
lines.en: We used to wash our hands at the well outside, you know.
lines.style: Wistful, half-smiling. Voice softens on the memory. Speaking with the ease of someone who lived it. Slight pause before 'well' — letting the image settle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 夏休み、補習、なくて、嬉しい!
lines.en: Summer break with no summer school — I'm so happy!
lines.style: Unabashed joy radiating through. Quick, energetic pacing. The relief of liberation in every syllable. Barely contained excitement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お祭りの花火、夜空で弾けると、感動するよ。
lines.en: Festival fireworks bursting in the night sky — that's something that really moves you.
lines.style: Warm, almost tender. Voice deepens slightly on 'night sky.' Speaking with the weight of genuine feeling. A man sharing something precious with a child he loves. Sustained, gentle close.
